codes.BAD_REQUEST: Something about that request wasn't right. Please try again.
codes.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you're looking for.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
codes.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
codes.UNTRUSTED_ORIGIN: This request was blocked for your security. Reload the page and try again.
codes.ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
codes.INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
codes.VERIFICATION_REQUIRED: Please confirm the code we sent you first.
codes.ACCOUNT_ALREADY_EXISTS: An account with these details already exists.
codes.INVITATION_INVALID: This invitation link isn't valid. It may have been used or revoked.
codes.INVITATION_EXPIRED: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
codes.PASSWORD_RESET_INVALID: This password reset link isn't valid. It may have been used already.
codes.PASSWORD_RESET_EXPIRED: This password reset link has expired. Request a new one.
codes.VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: That code isn't right. Please check it and try again.
codes.VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: That code has expired. Request a new one.
codes.TOTP_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up your authenticator app to continue.
codes.TOTP_CODE_INVALID: That authenticator code isn't right. Enter the current one.
codes.TOTP_CHALLENGE_INVALID: Your sign in timed out. Please enter your email and password again.
codes.TWO_FACTOR_RESET_INVALID: This two-factor reset link isn't valid. It may have been used already.
codes.TWO_FACTOR_RESET_EXPIRED: This two-factor reset link has expired. Ask another admin for a new one.
codes.CANNOT_TARGET_SELF: You can't do this to your own account.
codes.LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: You can't deactivate the last active admin.
codes.HAS_UPCOMING_TRIPS: It's on trips that are still live. Reassign or finish them first.
codes.DRIVER_PHONE_TAKEN: Another driver has this phone number.
codes.PLATE_NUMBER_TAKEN: Another vehicle has this plate number.
codes.OFFICE_REQUIRES_EXTERNAL: Only an external driver or vehicle can come through an office.
codes.OFFICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: That office doesn't exist or is archived.
codes.LOCATION_NOT_AVAILABLE: That place doesn't exist or has been deleted.
codes.IMAGE_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: Upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
codes.IMAGE_LIMIT_REACHED: This vehicle already has 5 images. Delete one first.
codes.LAST_TEAM_MANAGER: Someone active has to keep the team permission.
codes.LOCATION_NAME_TAKEN: Another place in the same parent already has this name.
codes.LOCATION_PARENT_INVALID: Choose a live parent that's broader than this place.
codes.LOCATION_DELETED: This place is deleted. Restore it first.
codes.LOCATION_NOT_RESTORABLE: This place can't be restored on its own. Restore the place it was deleted with, or its parent, first.
codes.LOCATION_COUNT_MISMATCH: The places under this one changed. Check the count and try again.
codes.OUT_OF_COVERAGE: We don't serve this place yet.
codes.TRIP_CLASS_NAME_TAKEN: Another active class already has this name.
codes.BRAND_NAME_TAKEN: Another active brand already has this name.
codes.PRICING_EXISTS: This route already has a price for this class and car. Change that price instead.
codes.QUOTE_SAME_PLACE: The pickup and the drop-off are in the same place. Choose a different drop-off.
codes.PICKUP_TIME_INVALID: Choose a pickup time at least 3 hours and at most 90 days ahead, on the quarter hour.
codes.LOAD_DOES_NOT_FIT: The passengers or luggage don't fit this car. Choose a bigger one.
codes.PENDING_TRIP_LIMIT: You already have 3 trips waiting for confirmation. Wait for one to be confirmed, or cancel one.
codes.PRICE_CHANGED: The price has changed since you saw it. Check the new price and try again.
codes.PRICE_REQUIRED: Give this trip a price, or book it for a customer.
codes.CUSTOMER_NOT_AVAILABLE: That customer doesn't exist or isn't active.
codes.TRIP_STATUS_CONFLICT: This trip has moved on. Refresh to see where it stands.
codes.CALL_TO_CANCEL: This trip is confirmed, so it can't be cancelled online. Please call us to cancel it.
codes.PRICE_NOT_ACCEPTED: The customer has to accept the price before the trip can be confirmed.
codes.ASSIGNMENT_REQUIRED: Assign a driver and a vehicle, or an office, before starting the trip.
codes.ASSIGNEE_BUSY: That driver or vehicle is already on a trip in progress.
codes.MONTH_REPORT_GENERATED: This month's report has been generated, so its trips can't be reopened.
codes.PRICE_NOT_REQUESTED: This trip isn't waiting for a price.
codes.PRICE_NOT_PROPOSED: There's no price waiting for your answer.
codes.PRICE_REQUEST_OPEN: This trip's price is waiting on the customer. Propose a price instead.
codes.DRIVER_NOT_AVAILABLE: That driver doesn't exist or is archived.
codes.VEHICLE_NOT_AVAILABLE: That vehicle doesn't exist or is archived.
codes.VEHICLE_TOO_SMALL: That vehicle is smaller than the car this trip was booked for.
codes.ASSIGNMENT_OFFICE_MISMATCH: A trip handed to an office can only have that office's driver and vehicle.
codes.ASSIGNMENT_CONFLICT: The driver or vehicle has another trip within 3 hours. Check it, then confirm to assign anyway.
codes.TRIP_ALREADY_LINKED: One of these trips is already linked to another. Unlink it first.
codes.TRIP_LINK_INVALID: These trips can't be linked. The return must be another trip picking up after the outbound.
codes.TRIP_NOT_LINKED: This trip isn't linked to another one.
codes.REPORT_LINK_INVALID: This report link doesn't work. It may have been replaced by a newer one: ask the office for the latest link.
codes.REPORT_LINK_EXPIRED: This report link has expired. Ask the office to fill in the report.
codes.REPORT_LINK_UNAVAILABLE: This trip has no driver yet, so it has no report link.
codes.REPORT_ALREADY_SUBMITTED: The report was already submitted. Ask the office if something needs changing.
codes.REPORT_REQUIRED: This trip needs its driver's report before it can be completed. Fill it in if the driver hasn't.
codes.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: That's too many trips for one file. Narrow the dates or filters and try again.
codes.REPORT_MONTH_NOT_OVER: A month's report can only be made once the month is over.
codes.NETWORK_ERROR: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
codes.UNEXPECTED_RESPONSE: Something went wrong. Please try again.

signIn.title: Sign in

resetPassword.description: You'll be signed out of your other devices.
resetPassword.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.
resetPassword.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

invite.title: Join Terhal
invite.description: You've been invited to the staff dashboard. Set up your account to continue.
invite.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a number.

linkExpired.description: Invitation and reset links only work once and for a limited time. Ask a colleague for a new invitation, or request a new reset link.

proposePrice.saveToPricing: Save it to the price list
proposePrice.saveToPricingHint: Later bookings of this route are priced at once.

cancelTrip.title: Cancel {code}?
cancelTrip.description: The booker is told. A cancelled trip can't be restarted.

assign.title: Assign {code}
assign.description: Only drivers who are free and vehicles big enough for the trip are listed.
assign.officeHint: Their driver and vehicle are optional.
assign.conflictTitle: Already on a trip within 3 hours
assign.conflictRefused: That driver or vehicle has a trip close by. Tick “Assign anyway” to go ahead.

reportLink.title: Report link
reportLink.description: Send it to {driver}. They fill their report in from it, no sign-in needed.
reportLink.regenerated: New link made. The old one no longer works.

linkReturn.title: Link a return trip
linkReturn.description: Pick the trip that brings the passengers of {code} back.

confirmTrip.title: Confirm {code}?
confirmTrip.description: The booker is told their trip is confirmed.

startTrip.title: Start this trip?
startTrip.description: Do this when the driver sets off.

endTrip.title: End this trip?
endTrip.description: The trip then waits for the driver's report.

unstartTrip.title: Undo the start?
unstartTrip.description: For a trip started by mistake: it goes back to confirmed.

completeTrip.title: Complete this trip?
completeTrip.description: The driver's fee and the expenses they paid, less the cash they collected, are written to their ledger.

reopenTrip.title: Reopen this trip?
reopenTrip.description: It goes back to awaiting report, and what completing wrote to the driver's ledger is reversed.

unlinkTrip.title: Unlink the return trip?
unlinkTrip.description: Both trips stay as they are, just no longer paired.
